# The Tech Buzz

> > Tech media company delivering curated technology news, analysis, and community engagement through newsletters, RSS feeds, and virtual events.

The Tech Buzz is a tech media platform launched in 2023 with over 1.1M subscribers, covering startup ecosystems, VC connections, brand partnerships, and technology trends. The platform offers multiple content distribution channels including Substack newsletters, RSS feeds, and a Virtual HQ for community networking.
